title: First-variation bound for the radial cutoff field under ‖δV‖ ≤ Λ μ_V
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^N, V an n-varifold on U (SimonGMT Varifold N n U), x ∈ ℝ^N, ρ0, Λ, A, t ∈ ℝ and φ : ℝ → ℝ. Assume: V has locally bounded first variation in U; ball x ρ0 ⊆ U; Λ ≥ 0; ‖δV‖(B_r(x)) ≤ ofReal(Λ)·μ_V(B_r(x)) for every r with 0 < r < ρ0, where ‖δV‖ = variationMeasure V, μ_V = V.weight and B_r(x) = closedBall x r; φ is C¹ (ContDiff ℝ 1) and antitone; φ(s) = 1 for every s ≤ 1; φ(s) = 0 for every s ≥ A²; A > 0; t > 0; t·A < ρ0. Then the first variation of the radial field X(y) = φ(|y − x|²/t²)·(y − x) satisfies |δV(X)| ≤ A·Λ·t·∫ φ(|y − x|²/t²) dμ_V(y), where δV(X) = V.firstVariation X = ∫ div_S X(y) dV(y,S) and the right-hand integral is a real (Bochner) integral.
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (x : Euclidean N) (ρ₀ Λ A t : ℝ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ), V.HasLocallyBoundedFirstVariation → ball x ρ₀ ⊆ U → 0 ≤ Λ → (∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r < ρ₀ → variationMeasure V (closedBall x r) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal Λ * V.weight (closedBall x r)) → ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → Antitone φ → (∀ s : ℝ, s ≤ 1 → φ s = 1) → (∀ s : ℝ, A ^ 2 ≤ s → φ s = 0) → 0 < A → 0 < t → t * A < ρ₀ → |V.firstVariation (fun y ↦ φ (‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / t ^ 2) • (y - x))| ≤ A * Λ * t * ∫ y, φ (‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / t ^ 2) ∂V.weight
